# Anipixels: full pack facts

> Anipixels makes royalty-free game asset packs named "Crisp ...": UI and gameplay sound effects, music loops and jingles, UI kits, icons, sprite-sheet and real-time Godot VFX, low-poly PS1-style 3D props and a Ren'Py GUI kit, plus a Godot 4 game template. The packs are sold on itch.io and direct by card on Payhip; each has a free sampler, and most have a playable browser demo. This site describes each pack, compares them by job, and offers three free browser tools built from the free samplers, plus how-to guides for Godot 4 and Ren'Py 8.

How it is made: Claude (an AI assistant) made every pack, by writing the code that makes each asset: the sounds are synthesised from scratch, the graphics are drawn shape by shape and the 3D props are modelled and textured by code. No AI image, audio or 3D generators, no recorded samples, no scans and no third-party art. Every pack is opened and tested in real engines before it goes on sale.
Licence (the LICENSE.txt in every pack and sampler): use the files in any number of commercial or non-commercial projects (games, apps, websites, videos, streams, game jams) and edit or modify them; credit is appreciated but never required; you may not resell, redistribute or give away the files themselves, on their own or inside another asset pack. Most of the licence files sum it up as: "put them in the things you make, just don't sell or share the pack." The music licence also forbids registering the music with Content ID or any other fingerprinting service.
Prices are in US dollars as listed on 9 November 2026; the store page always shows the current price. Every pack is sold on itch.io; packs with a Payhip link can also be bought direct by card there, at the same price.

Short version with links: https://anipixels.github.io/llms.txt . Comparison by job, with a FAQ: https://anipixels.github.io/packs/compare/ .
The Crisp Everything Bundle contains all 18 packs below for $17.99 (the single prices add up to $107.82): https://itch.io/s/203391/crisp-everything-bundle , or direct by card: https://payhip.com/b/Q371Z . Crisp Cozy Starter (at the end) is sold on its own and is not in the bundle.

## Crisp UI

- Page: https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-ui/
- Kind: Sound effects pack
- Summary: Crisp UI is a pack of 583 sound effects for game menus, HUDs, inventories, dialogue, rewards and mobile UI: clicks, hovers, toggles, sliders and drag and drop, confirm and error feedback, notifications, menu transitions, dialogue voices, reward jingles, coins and 3 seamless loops, plus 4 complete style sets (Retro 8-bit, Sci-Fi, Fantasy RPG, Soft minimal) that share one list of file names. Every sound comes as WAV and OGG. Version 2.0 (12 Nov 2026) grew it from 242 sounds, free for everyone who already owns it.
- Contents: 583 sounds in 16 folders
- Formats: WAV (44.1 kHz, 16-bit, stereo) and OGG Vorbis
- Price: $4.99 on itch.io: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-ui ; direct by card on Payhip: https://payhip.com/b/zLt4y
- Free sampler: 20 sounds, and a playable browser demo of the full pack: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-ui-free
- In the Crisp Everything Bundle: yes

What is included:
- Buttons (75): soft, hard, wood, glass, plastic, metal and bubble clicks, hovers, pops, press / release, select, back; gamepad focus moves, a near-silent hover, a disabled button, a long press
- Toggles (45): toggles, switches, tabs, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, knobs, steppers, slider and scroll ticks; a heavy lever switch, a segmented control
- Feedback (48): confirm, cancel, error, warning, locked, denied, save, undo / redo, delete, send / receive, loading; save / load game, connected / disconnected
- Notifications (40): chimes, messages, urgent alerts, reminders, timer ticks, countdown 3-2-1-go; toasts, a counter badge, time up, new mail
- Menus (39): menu open / close, swipes, panels, popups, page turns, zoom, drawers; modals, tooltips, accordions, pause / unpause
- Rewards (39): achievement, level up, unlock, quest complete, jingles, stars, XP, combos, chests, badges, trophies; quest accept / update / fail, new ability
- Pickups (25): coins, gems, heal, power-up, key, items, hearts, stars, energy, shield, tokens
- Shop (10): purchase, not enough money, sell, equip / unequip, upgrade, craft, cart add / remove
- Text (73): typing, enter / space / backspace, dialogue blips in three pitches; three dialogue voices at three pitches, text reveal ticks, a typewriter and a mechanical keyboard
- Sliders & Drag (25): slider grab / release, a tuned 8-step slider ladder, drag and drop (lift, drop, snap into a slot, spring back), the rubber band at the end of a list
- Inventory (17): items picked out of a slot, set in and swapped, auto-sort, inventory full, a ring equipped, an item used
- Loops (3): 3 seamless loops: charge, loading, scroll
- Style - Retro (36): a complete Retro 8-bit UI kit in C major with the same 36 file names as every other style folder
- Style - Sci-Fi (36): a complete Sci-Fi UI kit in D Dorian with the same 36 file names
- Style - Fantasy (36): a complete Fantasy RPG UI kit in G major with the same 36 file names
- Style - Soft (36): a complete Soft minimal UI kit in F major with the same 36 file names

Files and formats:
- WAV: 44.1 kHz, 16-bit, stereo (for editing and highest quality).
- OGG Vorbis: small files, ready for Godot, Unity, GameMaker and web.
- Every sound is loudness-matched, starts on its first sample (no dead air) and peaks at or below -1 dBFS.

Works with: Any engine or tool that plays WAV or OGG files. The pack's README names Godot, Unity, GameMaker and web.

Details:
- 583 sounds in 16 folders (263 named sounds; 102 of them come in 3 or more takes), so repeated clicks and pickups do not sound robotic.
- 4 style sets x 36 files with identical names (click, hover, select, confirm, cancel, error, open, close, toggles, slider tick, notify, text blip, unlock): point your code at another folder and the whole UI changes style.
- 3 tuned ladders: slider_step (8 steps), combo_up (4 steps), star (3 steps); 3 seamless stereo loops: charge, loading, scroll.
- Loudness-matched (quiet hovers, louder confirms), peaks at or below -1 dBFS; WAV 44.1 kHz / 16-bit and OGG Vorbis, plus a 48 kHz / 24-bit master of the 341 new sounds.
- Godot 4 sound bank included (tested headless in Godot 4.7.2); a Unity package and notes (not tested inside Unity); sounds.csv data sheet.
- Every 1.x file is unchanged in v2.0: same names, same folders, same audio.

Free sampler: The free sampler has 20 of the 583 sounds as WAV and OGG: click soft, click wood, hover soft, toggle on, toggle off, confirm, cancel, error, notification 03, menu open, menu close, achievement, level up, retro confirm, fantasy unlock, soft toggle on, scifi notify, item swap, voice mumble mid and level up small (the nine sounds the Godot UI-sound guide's code loads are all in it).

Licence: Use the sounds in any number of commercial or non-commercial projects (games, apps, websites, videos, streams, game jams). Edit, layer, pitch or otherwise modify them. Credit is appreciated but never required. You may not resell, redistribute or give away the sounds themselves, on their own or as part of another sound library or asset pack, modified or not, and you may not claim them as your own original work in a sound library.

How it was made: Every sound is synthesised from scratch by code that was written with Claude, an AI assistant. No recorded samples and no AI audio-generation models were used.

## Crisp Puzzle

- Page: https://anipixels.github.io/packs/crisp-puzzle/
- Kind: Sound effects pack
- Summary: Crisp Puzzle is a pack of 355 sound effects for match-3 and casual puzzle games - bubble shooters, block puzzles, merge games, ball sort, mahjong and tile-match, word games, jigsaws and logic grids: swaps, matches, gem landings, specials, obstacles, rewards, level flow, menus, 4 seamless loops and three 12-step cascade ladders tuned to C major pentatonic. Version 2.0 (12 Nov 2026) grew it from 100 sounds, free for everyone who already owns it.
- Contents: 355 sounds in 19 folders
- Formats: WAV (44.1 kHz, 16-bit, stereo) and OGG Vorbis
- Price: $5.99 on itch.io: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-puzzle ; direct by card on Payhip: https://payhip.com/b/D6iSt
- Free sampler: 20 sounds, and a playable browser demo of the full pack: https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-puzzle-free
- In the Crisp Everything Bundle: yes

What is included:
- Tiles (27): select, deselect, swap, invalid swap, tile land; gems landing, whole columns landing, a clinking gem swap, drag ticks
- Matches (21): match 3 / 4 / 5; a softer marimba match set, T / L matches, a six-match and candy pops
- Combo Ladders (39): two 12-step cascade ladders (bells, plucks), a 12-step kalimba ladder and three chain-end chords
- Specials (18): line / bomb / colour gem created, line blast, bomb, colour bomb, booster, hammer; rockets, a lit fuse, the rainbow firing
- Board (21): shuffle, no moves, hint, moves low, score ticks, 1 / 2 / 3 stars; hint glows, the board building in, goals
- Falling Blocks (20): move, rotate, lock, hard drop, 1-4 line clears; hold, spawn, soft drop, a perfect clear
- Push & Break (20): push, goal, door, ice, glass, crate, jelly; two-layer ice, a crate taking a hit, an unbreakable metal block
- Map & Jingles (9): map steps, level select, unlock, level start, level complete, level fail, board clear
- Block Puzzle (16): pick up, place (2-5 cubes), a piece snapping back, rotate, one to four lines cleared (rising), the board full
- Bubble Shooter (22): aim ticks, launch, wall bounce, stick, pop, cluster pops, loose bubbles dropping, the ceiling moving down
- Merge (23): an 8-step tuned merge ladder, the top tier, generators, picking up and dropping items, orders completed
- Sort Puzzles (10): balls lifted out of and dropped into glass tubes, a tube completed, a move not allowed, everything sorted
- Mahjong & Words (24): tiles picked, clacking, pairs matched, tiles flying into the tray; letter tiles, word found, not a word, bonus word
- Jigsaw (13): pieces picked up, snapped into place, refusing to fit, the box tipped out, the picture complete
- Number & Logic (15): sudoku / nonogram / logic grids: cell taps, fills, pencil cross-outs, right and wrong entries, solved
- Level Flow (18): level complete with 1 / 2 / 3 stars, out of moves, timer tick / tock, time up, countdown and go, pause, retry
- Rewards (20): coins, gems collected, the daily reward, boosters, lives lost / gained / refilled, a new high score, the prize wheel
- UI (15): a matching casual menu set: buttons, back, popups opening and closing, toggles, tabs, a notification, a soft error
- Loops (4): 4 seamless stereo loops: fuse, score count, special shimmer, timer tick

Files and formats:
- WAV: 44.1 kHz, 16-bit, stereo (for editing and highest quality).
- OGG Vorbis: small files, ready for Godot, Unity, GameMaker and web.
- Every sound is loudness-matched, starts on its first sample (no dead air) and peaks at or below -1 dBFS.

Works with: Any engine or tool that plays WAV or OGG files. The pack's README names Godot, Unity, GameMaker and web.

Details:
- 355 sounds in 19 folders (174 named sounds; 95 of them come in 2-4 takes), so a falling board never sounds robotic.
- 5 tuned ladders in C major pentatonic: combo_bell, combo_pluck and combo_kalimba (12 steps each), merge_step (8), star_award (3): play the next step for each chained match and a cascade turns into a little melody.
- 4 seamless stereo loops: fuse, score count, special shimmer, timer tick.
- Loudness-matched, peaks at or below -1 dBFS; WAV 44.1 kHz / 16-bit and OGG Vorbis.
- Godot 4 sound bank included (one line to play any sound, takes picked for you); Unity notes included.
- Every v1.0 file is unchanged in v2.0: same names, same folders, same audio.

Credit is appreciated but never required. - Kind: Music jingles pack
- Summary: Crisp Jingles is a pack of 45 short musical stingers for games: 15 moments such as level complete, game over and item get, each written once and produced in three styles (chiptune, cozy and synth-pop) with the same melody.
- Contents: 45 jingles: 15 moments x 3 styles (chiptune, cozy, synth-pop)

- Synth Pop (15): 15 moments, one file each

Files and formats:
- WAV: 44.1 kHz, 16-bit, stereo (for editing and highest quality).
- OGG Vorbis: small files, ready for Godot, Unity, GameMaker and web.
- Every sound is loudness-matched, starts on its first sample (no dead air) and peaks at or below -1 dBFS.

Works with: Any engine or tool that plays WAV or OGG files. The pack's README names Godot, Unity, GameMaker and web.

Details:
- 45 jingles in 3 folders: 15 moments x 3 styles.
- Each jingle exists in all three styles with the same melody: pick the style that fits your game, or mix them (for example chiptune in levels, cozy in menus).
- Every file ends in its own natural reverb tail, so jingles never cut off abruptly.
- Jingles are mixed a little louder than typical sound effects, so duck your music under them.

Free sampler: The free sampler has 9 of the 45 jingles as WAV and OGG: level complete, game over and item get, each in all three styles.

Details:
- Version 2.0 (26 October 2026): the pack grew from 261 to 1,363 sounds, a free update for existing owners. Every v1.0 file is unchanged.

## Crisp Cozy Starter

- Kind: Godot 4 game template (no page on this site; the itch.io page is the reference)
- Summary: A finished cozy first-person game for Godot 4 to open, play and make your own: farming, cooking, dialogue, inventory, day / night, save / load, menus and settings, with a PS1-style look.
- Contents: A complete Godot 4 project: 40 GDScript files (about 3500 lines, typed and commented), 83 ready-to-place prop scenes, the Crisp Cute UI theme in six colour palettes, 30 item icons, 94 sound files and 111 automated tests
- Formats: Godot 4 project (pure GDScript, Compatibility renderer)

- In the Crisp Everything Bundle: no

Systems included:
- First-person player: walk, sprint, jump, mouse and right-stick look, footsteps that change with the floor
- Interaction: doors, beds, the stove, the mailbox, the cat, pickups and garden beds share one Interactable base class
- Inventory and hotbar: 24 slots (8 on the hotbar), stacking, move / swap / merge with mouse or controller
- Farming: plant, water, crops grow overnight through 3 model stages, harvest (turnips, wheat, pumpkins)
- Cooking / crafting: data-driven recipes per station (4 recipes at the wood stove)
- Dialogue: branching conversations as resources, with flags, item checks, gifts and typewriter text
- Day / night and sleep: clock from 6 am to 2 am; the bed skips to morning and auto-saves
- Save / load: one readable JSON file
- Menus and settings: main menu, pause menu, volumes, mouse and stick speed, invert Y, fullscreen, PSX look on / off
- Keyboard and controller support for every action and menu
- PSX look: low-res render, vertex snapping, affine textures, 15-bit colour and dither

Works with: Godot 4.4 or newer, standard or .NET build (pure GDScript). Built and tested in Godot 4.7.2.

Licence: Use the code and the assets in any number of commercial or non-commercial games, no credit needed. You may not resell or redistribute the kit, its code as a template, or its assets on their own. The Fredoka font is under the SIL Open Font License.

How it was made: Claude (an AI assistant) designed everything in this pack. The code was written by Claude, the 3D models were built from code, the UI graphics drawn by code and the sounds synthesized in code. No AI image, 3D or audio generators, no third-party art or sound.
